calls.title: Sync re: Approval Flows
calls.summary: The team discussed several improvements to the approval requests and diff presentation workflows. They redesigned the approval requests page to prioritize pending reviews and implemented sorting by status and date for better usability. Concerns were raised regarding irrelevant reviews flooding users in large organizations, leading to the decision to enhance filtering based on user permissions and teams. For the version diff, a full-page layout was preferred over a modal to improve navigation, and it was agreed to provide both user-friendly summaries and raw data views. Participants emphasized the need for distinct views for auditing and quick reviews, and a tabbed interface was endorsed for smoother workflows. Customer feedback, particularly from Anthropic, highlighted tailored design requirements to accommodate advanced auditing needs.
calls.keywords: Approval Flows, Version Diff, Revision Comparison, Review Tab, Raw Data View, UI Design
calls.action_items:
**Guy Langford-lee**
Conduct a technical spike to explore feasible filtering options for approval requests to better manage large organizational data volumes and report findings (10:55)
Continue transitioning the review and publish modal into a dedicated tab with enhanced detail views to improve the auditing and review experience (50:20)

**Kari Kay**
Refine UI designs for revision change summaries to improve visual hierarchy and reduce clutter, considering two-column layouts and expandable rows (23:25)
Prepare for and participate in the upcoming discovery session with Anthropic to discuss further refinements and gather customer feedback (01:06:09)

**Bryce Fitzsimons**
Share insights on current user workflows for revision comparisons and review modes during next design discussions to inform UI improvements (40:26)
Support integration of raw JSON diff views for customers requiring unfiltered data outputs alongside human-readable views (30:35)
Oversee design decisions to maintain clear separation between audit and review UI surfaces and ensure ease of navigation between them (50:20)
